generated_response: Mammals reproduce through sexual reproduction. During this process, females produce an egg (ovum) and males produce sperm. The fertilized egg, containing genetic material from both parents, moves into the uterus of the female. This fertilized egg then develops into a fetus, which eventually gives birth to the offspring.
